AnagnostouNorbury.checked: Pure-cone pair-sum chamber, area/stability, weighted compactification, small-cone mixed regime, sufficiently large positive boundary in the nonnodal degeneration example.

AMN.location: Definitions 2.12–2.13; Lemma 2.14; weighted stability domain in Section 2
AMN.checked: Weighted WP class, geometric top intersection, reduction pullback coefficient(1−sum weights)^2.

HuTan.checked: Torus involution and sphere Klein-four action; degree2/4 common quotient; matching simple-curve lengths.

FillastreMetrics.location: Theorem1.1 and congruence qualification, printed page2; Section1.3, printed page3
FillastreMetrics.checked: Genus-zero hyperbolic metric with finitely many positive-curvature cone singularities, cusps and complete infinite-area ends has a unique finite-vertex convex generalized hyperbolic realization up to congruence. The funnel/cusp input is the case without finite cone singularities. Section1.3 explicitly attributes the proof to Schlenker.
FillastreMetrics.limit: This is a precise external statement check, not an independent global proof. Version2 is a separate two-page erratum concerning parabolic/Fuchsian connectedness; the theorem statement is pinned to version1.
